name: usbless-dualboot
description: Install Windows alongside Linux on UEFI without a USB stick: probe the layout, plan the split, shrink the Linux partition, stage a FAT32 installer partition, and add the boot entry
requires: Install the usbless-dualboot Bash CLI separately and put it on PATH; Linux in UEFI/GPT mode, root for mutating phases, btrfs for online shrink, jq, sfdisk, lsblk
